scope: Initial US, euro-area and UK design profiles; national and participant overlays remain required.

timing.notes: Batch and Same Day ACH options require applicable cutoffs, settlement date, SEC code and bank access.

US-ACH.finality: Settlement does not extinguish eligible returns; return rights depend on SEC, reason, consumer status and timing.
US-ACH.returns: Native ACH return/reversal processes; reversal is restricted error correction, not general refund.
US-ACH.funding: ODFI/RDFI settlement and customer funding under bank agreement.
US-ACH.access: Evidence of contracted participant/sponsor access and actual endpoint reachability required; listing a rail does not prove access.
limitations: Design profile only; not operating authority, legal applicability or production certification.
No universal amount limit, fee, customer cutoff or return deadline is inferred.

timing.notes: RTGS during operating schedule; bank customer cutoff can precede system cutoff.

US-FEDWIRE.finality: Fedwire settlement is final and irrevocable; uncertain messages require status verification.
US-FEDWIRE.returns: A return request is a separate request and not unilateral rollback.
US-FEDWIRE.access: Evidence of contracted participant/sponsor access and actual endpoint reachability required; listing a rail does not prove access.
limitations: Design profile only; not operating authority, legal applicability or production certification.
No universal amount limit, fee, customer cutoff or return deadline is inferred.

timing.notes: Continuous immediate processing, subject to receiver reachability and participant controls.

US-FEDNOW.finality: Accepted settlement is final; request-for-payment is a request, not consent or funds.
US-FEDNOW.returns: camt.056 request, camt.029 response and pacs.004 return are distinct.
US-FEDNOW.funding: Master/correspondent account settlement; not the RTP prefunded joint-account model.
US-FEDNOW.access: Evidence of contracted participant/sponsor access and actual endpoint reachability required; listing a rail does not prove access.
limitations: Design profile only; not operating authority, legal applicability or production certification.
No universal amount limit, fee, customer cutoff or return deadline is inferred.
US-FEDNOW.source_version: FedNow Operating Procedures February 2026 v3.5; confirm replacement versions before operational use.

timing.notes: Immediate credit transfers through reachable RTP participants.

US-RTP.finality: Completed transfers are final and irrevocable; return agreement is separate.
US-RTP.returns: Request for return and subsequent return do not undo settlement automatically.
US-RTP.funding: Sending participant prefunded position in RTP settlement arrangement.
US-RTP.access: Evidence of contracted participant/sponsor access and actual endpoint reachability required; listing a rail does not prove access.
limitations: Design profile only; not operating authority, legal applicability or production certification.
No universal amount limit, fee, customer cutoff or return deadline is inferred.
US-RTP.source_version: Current 2026-06-01 rules; announced 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-04 changes require rereview.
